jonah.2.p1.b1.text: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God,

jonah.2.p1.b2.text: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me.

jonah.2.p1.b3.text: From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.

jonah.2.p1.b4.text: For You cast me into the deep … all Your breakers and waves swept over me.

jonah.2.p2.b1.text: At this, I said, ‘I have been banished from Your sight; yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.’

jonah.2.p2.b2.text: The waters engulfed me to take my life … the seaweed wrapped around my head.

jonah.2.p2.b3.text: To the roots of the mountains I descended; the earth beneath me barred me in forever!

jonah.2.p3.b1.text: But You raised my life from the pit, O LORD my God!

jonah.2.p3.b2.text: As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.

jonah.2.p3.b3.text: Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.

jonah.2.p3.b4.text: But I, with the voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You. I will fulfill what I have vowed.

jonah.2.p4.b2.text: And the LORD commanded the fish

jonah.2.p4.b3.text: and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
